D: Agent J travels back to 1969 to save a young Agent K from an alien assassin.
P: Serve dessert when young K and J stop for pie at the diner.
S: J chasing Boris through 1969 Coney Island
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in wax paper.
the Chinese restaurant full of aliens
Pork and prawn dumplings steamed in bamboo baskets for 8 minutes, with soy and chilli oil.
Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into a ball, coated in chopped walnuts, served with crackers.
M: the Apollo 11 launch at Cape Canaveral
Beef patties grilled to medium, cheddar melted on, in toasted buns with lettuce, tomato and onion, with crinkle fries.
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and peas.
W: young K's favourite pie at the diner
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: the agents in their black suits
Strong black coffee in thick diner mugs, refilled without asking.

s.note: J chasing Boris through 1969 Coney Island
s.how: Warm 300g sauerkraut in a small pan with a pinch of caraway seeds. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns, add a stripe of yellow mustard and a pile of sauerkraut, then wrap each in wax paper like a boardwalk stand.

s.note: the Chinese restaurant full of aliens
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, grated ginger and a splash of soy. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Steam in a lined bamboo basket for 8 minutes. Serve hot with soy sauce and chilli oil for dipping.

m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar. Bake at 180C for an hour. Serve thick slices with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and peas.

w.note: young K's favourite pie at the diner
w.how: Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice on top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the agents in their black suits
d.how: Brew a big pot of strong black coffee from freshly ground beans. Pour into thick diner mugs and keep the pot hot. Set a small jug of milk on the table for anyone who wants it, and refill every mug without being asked.
